description: In July 2023, Diversey was bought by Solenis. The agreement unites two of the industry's heavyweights with activities in related and highly complementary markets. Identify opportunities to sell spare parts, consumables, and service contracts. Deliver an excellent customer experience before, during, and after each service visit. Plan and schedule customer visits accurately and efficiently, with weekly activity reporting. Train customers on the features, operation, and proper use of purchased products. Requirements Mechanical and electrical skills, with experience troubleshooting increasingly electronic machinery. Relevant industry experience with the ability to provide technical advice and support to customers. Minimum O-Level/Secondary School, Nitec, or Diploma , preferably in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering. 2–3 years of relevant experience in a similar technical/service role is preferred. Basic computer skills for service reporting and system updates. Valid Class 3 driving licence . Good basic spoken and written English; additional languages are an advantage.

Solenis has been recognized as a Best Managed Company for 4 consecutive years and was named as 2024 Best Managed Company Gold Standard Winner. Job Summary We are seeking a detail-oriented and analytical Supply Planning Executive to join our supply-chain team. The role involves planning and managing supply and inventory for finished goods (non-chemical equipment), ensuring that demand is met efficiently while maintaining optimal inventory levels. The Supply Planning Executive will coordinate across functions such as procurement, production/operations, sales/distribution, logistics, and demand forecasting to assure smooth supply flow and customer service levels. Key Responsibilities Develop and maintain supply plans based on demand forecasts, sales trends and business requirements. Monitor and manage inventory levels (finished goods, safety stock, buffer stock, etc.) — ensuring adequate stock to meet demand without overstocking. Raise, manage and process purchase orders (POs), purchase requisitions, and follow-up until delivery. Monitor and manage supplier performance, vendor relationships and ensure timely vendor payments Coordinate with suppliers/vendors, third-party logistics (3PL) providers, manufacturing/operations teams, and distribution/warehouse partners to ensure timely supply and delivery. Work closely with demand planning / sales / marketing / operations teams to align supply planning with demand changes, promotions, seasonality, new launches, etc. Conduct regular inventory audits and reconciliation to maintain stock accuracy and data integrity (ERP/MRP system or internal systems). Generate and present supply-chain / inventory reports and KPIs (stock-outs, inventory turnover, forecast vs actual, supply-performance, service levels) to senior management. Identify supply-chain risks (e.g. stock-outs, supplier delays, over-stocking) and implement mitigation / corrective actions proactively. Support order fulfilment, distribution planning, and coordinate with logistics / warehouse / distribution teams to ensure on-time delivery to customers/retailers. Continuously analyse supply-chain processes and suggest improvements to increase efficiency, reduce costs, and optimize inventory management. Qualifications / Skills Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Operations, or related field. 2–5 years (or relevant) experience in supply planning, inventory management, or supply chain operations — preferably in FMCG / consumer goods/manufacturing / distribution setting. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills; ability to forecast demand, interpret data and trends, and make data-driven decisions. Good communication and collaboration skills — able to coordinate with multiple internal teams (sales, procurement, operations, logistics) and external stakeholders (suppliers, warehouses, distributors). Proficiency with MS Office (Excel, PowerPoint, etc.); familiarity with ERP / MRP / supply-chain software or systems is a plus. Organizational skills, attention to detail, ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities, meet deadlines. Basic understanding of inventory metrics / KPIs (stock-out rate, inventory turnover, safety stock, lead times, service levels). Proactive mindset — identifying potential issues early and recommending corrective actions; continuous improvement orientation. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) Inventory turnover / Days of Inventory Stock-out rate / Service level (OTIF – On Time In Full) Inventory carrying costs / cost of excess inventory Ideal Candidate The ideal candidate is a self-driven, organised professional with strong analytical skills and a collaborative mindset. They are comfortable working in a dynamic environment with fluctuating demand; able to interact with multiple stakeholders; adept at data-driven decision-making; and focused on balancing supply reliability with cost-efficiency.

title: Sr Territory Manager
description: Exempt, Grade 14 Sales Incentive Program ( SIP ) eligible GENERAL SCOPE Manages an assigned account, or group of accounts, with the primary responsibility to create value for the assigned customers through the technical service they provide; and identifying new product opportunities and selling to existing customers. A Sales Service Professional’s sole focus is to maintain revenue, price capture and to improve gross profit. Meet account sales penetration goals. Increase sales through new account sales and penetrate target market sectors by introducing new value added systems by identifying prospects, scheduling sales calls and successfully closing sale; meeting new account sales goals. Provide regularly scheduled preventative maintenance , manage delivery of product, installation of equipment and emergency service while selling systems benefits to maintain current customer base. Merchandise basic in-service training for warewashing, kitchen ancillaries, room care, laundry and floor care procedures. Educate and train customers on proper handling of chemicals and care of equipment; reinforce safe use of products at customer accounts. Manage outstanding accounts receivable and resolve customer concerns and problems.

title: Territory Manager
description: Job Role: The Territory Account Manager position is highly focused on customer account management and ongoing service, support and sales development with respective accounts. This position primarily focuses on service and selling (additional products, tools and services) to existing accounts with an additional emphasis on new accounts. This is a direct, customer-facing sales role with responsibility to retain existing revenues and close new revenue opportunities with both existing and new customers. Primary Position Responsibilities: Effectively provide account management and ongoing service, support, and sales development to respective accounts in a defined geography and sector(s). Implement white spot prospecting to include existing products, new products and innovations, enhanced sustainability and operational efficiencies (water, energy, chemical usage), and where appropriate food safety solutions. Monitor and report for both respective accounts and aligned Key Accounts by utilizing corresponding tools, such as Sales Funnels, quarterly reporting, market share analysis, and other reports requested by central stakeholders and supervisors. Work intensely and directly on application expertise and execution delivery, including customer training and merchandising, to reinforce value proposition and brand equity. Hold monthly and quarterly review sessions with customers’ heads of department/ stakeholders. Grow sales in geographic area and sector(s) by identifying, analyzing, and addressing opportunities for new customer acquisition as well as within existing customers through product and application recommendations. Continuously focus on sales growth execution and sales target achievement. Liaise with TCS to ensure appropriate service support for respective accounts. Consult with Key Account Managers or District/Sector Managers to ensure account management support delivered in respective accounts. Lead on time account receivable collection and prevent overdue Capabilities and Strengths: A Bachelor’s Degree Holder With at least 2 years job related experience Excellent interpersonal and communication skills (written and verbal). Solid demonstrated presentation skills with ability to convey complex information to a broad audience. Strong time management skills with the ability to multi-task while being flexible with changing demands. Self-starter and results-oriented individual with the confidence to take risk and partner with business leaders as required. High sense of drive and urgency with a positive outlook. Ability to implement problem solving techniques in order to resolve customer issues and take corrective action. Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret and utilize data and strategic tools to improve sales, meet goals, identify opportunities, and exceed customer expectations. Demonstrated sales skills and/or training with ability to utilize consultative sales techniques. Ability to work independently as well as thrive in a cooperative work environment. Proficient in Microsoft Office applications, especially Word, Excel, and PowerPoint
